scope: Only dispatcher source, usage and public developer-role text read. No credential, state, conversation, local settings or request data accessed. No shared files changed, external CLI/model invoked or grant created.

requirements.detail: Python >=3.10 required by Path.write_text(newline=...) at1196; Python3.12 matches prior Windows setup. stdlib only. Invoke with absolute Python executable and hook path; hook has no shebang.

Absolute ANTIGRAVITY_CLI_PATH selects existing file; otherwise shutil.which('agy') works on POSIX. Export absolute Mac executable path to actual hook process, not only interactive shell. Existing-file check does not verify executable permission; Mac binary must be executable and CLI-compatible. Root separately verifies official installer/options.

Dispatcher passes --agent codex-developer by name; does not load role file itself. Actual source role is ~/.gemini/config/agents/codex-developer.md (not review/roles). Install role at Mac CLI-supported global role location, verify discovery using official CLI documentation. Role has no Windows paths, prohibits commands/network/other agents, inherits model.

Windows Python/path/PowerShell examples in USAGE55-75 cannot run on Mac. Register UserPromptSubmit and Stop against the same Mac-installed hook with absolute paths using the Mac host supported hook format. Actual local settings were deliberately not read; exact host registration syntax is root's documentation verification gate.

Writable project, CODEX_HOME/review, temporary directory and authorized CLI user storage are required; CLI needs executable permission. Use normal Mac user, approved execution context and fresh local login. No copied Windows credentials, grants, consumed requests, sessions or databases.

Files/subprocess UTF8 explicit; stdin/stdout uses interpreter defaults. PYTHONUTF8=1 and PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 eliminate locale dependence; source/context must be UTF8. Do not rewrite snapshot newlines before baseline verification.

portable_code.detail: workflow lock selects nonblocking fcntl.flock on POSIX; short state transaction uses blocking flock. Both unlock/close in finally. Existing Windows msvcrt imports are branch-local.
subprocess argv list with shell=False default; no cmd.exe/PowerShell dependency. Working directory is temporary workspace, inherited environment, explicit UTF8 and bounded timeout.

pathlib resolution, os.sep overlap check, tempfile and same-directory atomic replace support POSIX. Fresh Mac repository must not reuse Windows worktree .git pointer. Recreate local worktree/checkout and verify baseline separately.

Paths are casefolded for workflow key and conflicts. On case-sensitive Mac volumes this conservatively merges case-only distinctions; avoid case-only project/file variants. Not an authorization bypass or a blocker for the present project.

patches.target: Mac hook registration and installation instructions
patches.detail: Replace Windows absolute interpreter/script/CLI paths and PowerShell invocation with Mac absolute paths and zsh-compatible startup. Supply environment to the GUI/host hook process explicitly. Do not transplant old hook state.

Delivery recreates a temporary file then replace, without preserving existing POSIX mode; executable scripts can lose execute bits. Capture original stat.S_IMODE, chmod replacement before replace and preserve on rollback; new files need an explicit policy, not blanket +x. No environment variable can preserve inode mode through current replacement. For present nonexecutable TS/TSX scope, no startup blocker; no-patch workaround is exclude executable files or explicitly restore known reviewed mode after delivery before validation.

Gate Windows .exe/WinGet candidate searches under os.name=='nt'; expanduser+resolve explicit executable overrides and check os.access(X_OK) on POSIX. Absolute valid override already avoids this issue; no mandatory source patch for current Mac setup.

Windows-specific login/permission advice should distinguish Mac current-user credential context. These are guidance strings, not Windows-only runtime APIs; do not claim Windows Credential Manager exists on Mac.

no_patch_environment.ANTIGRAVITY_CLI_PATH: Absolute path of official Mac agy executable, discovered after installation; not a .exe or shell command.
no_patch_environment.CODEX_HOME: Absolute writable Mac Codex home used consistently by host and dispatcher; empty local workflow state, never restored from Windows.
no_patch_environment.PATH: Include official CLI directory if no explicit override; GUI may not inherit shell login configuration.
no_patch_environment.TMPDIR: Normally leave Mac default; override only to an existing writable local temp directory if required.
no_patch_environment.CLAUDE_CODE_PATH: Optional absolute Mac Claude executable only for separately authorized future review; no Claude install/call required for Antigravity development.

verification.limitation: Windows-host extracted-function mocks only; no real macOS lock/filesystem/CLI execution or login verification.

packaging: Ship only public source/role/docs and these audit reports as selected by packager. Exclude state directories, authorization/session records, request JSON files (including synthetic ones), credentials/DBs/logs. Public source schema field names are code, not portable authorization. Fresh explicit human authorization on Mac must create a new local workflow; this audit grants no model call.
next_gate: Root verifies official Mac CLI/role/host registration documentation and baseline package. On Mac first verify Python/version/path/executable/role locally without model calls; any actual no-tool model probe or development dispatch requires fresh applicable human authorization.
